transtype.name: dogsbay
transtype.desc: dogsbay site project (Markdown, navigation, site config)

param.name: dogsbay.cli
param.desc: The dogsbay CLI: a command on the PATH, or an absolute path to its bin script. When given, it converts instead of the plugin's converter/publish-dita.mjs

param.name: dogsbay.node
param.desc: The Node.js executable that runs a script converter or site builder (default: node on the PATH)

param.name: dogsbay.family.links
param.desc: Parent, previous and next topic links after each topic, as the html5 output has them (a dogsbay site has previous/next buttons and a sidebar)

param.name: dogsbay.numbering
param.desc: Number titled tables and figures (Table 1., Figure 1.) as the html5 output does

param.name: dogsbay.ssg
param.desc: The dogsbay-ssg site builder: an absolute path to its build.mjs, or a dogsbay-ssg command on the PATH (default: the plugin's ssg/build.mjs). It must be build.mjs, not the CLI's bin script, and a copied build.mjs will not work on its own: it loads chunks/ from beside itself
